## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New logic has tests; a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Any number or claim in docs or comments comes from a check I ran or a source I link
- [ ] If this changes who gets warned (a threshold or data source), I explained the evidence
- [ ] No secrets, keys or phone numbers are included
- [ ] I did not weaken a safety control (rate limits, confirmation flow, message cap, encryption), or I explained why
